conceptual_change: Introduce a conditional volatility filter into the execution engine that restricts trade entry when ATR_14 exceeds the 1.5 standard deviation threshold of its 20-period moving average.
evidence_sources: research/BTCUSDT_1h_result_v2.json: dataset and baseline execution provenance
rationale: The failure in BC 17 was due to a lack of engine implementation for the volatility gatekeeper. BC 18 addresses this by formalizing the gatekeeper into the execution logic to test if curbing high-volatility entries improves signal reliability.
